newsitem.title: USA: EDO wins contract with McDonnell Douglass. [CORRECTED 21:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: EDO wins contract with McDonnell Douglass. [CORRECTED 21:00 GMT]

text.p: EDO Corp said Tuesday that it has been awarded two contracts, totaling $8.7 million, to build an undisclosed number of bomb release units for McDonnell Douglas Aerospace. (Corrects from "to build over 4,800 bomb release units" to "to build an undisclosed number of bomb release units")
The company said delivery of the units, which will be used on McDonnell Douglas's F-15E aircraft, will begin in February, 1999 and extend into 2000.
EDO is a supplier of advanced elctro-optical, electronic, mechanical acoustic and composite products to defense contractors and commercial original equipment makers.
